prompt: Explain LoRA in one sentence for a new ML engineer.
chosen: LoRA freezes the base model and trains small low-rank adapters so fine-tuning uses far less memory.
rejected: LoRA deletes half the layers of the network so training finishes faster on CPU.

prompt: When should I prefer QLoRA over full fine-tuning?
chosen: Prefer QLoRA when GPU memory is tight or you need to iterate quickly on a mid-size instruct model.
rejected: Always prefer full fine-tuning because quantized training is never accurate enough for production.
